import { AsyncLocalStorage } from "node:async_hooks"
import type { Persistence } from "../../../runtime/contract.ts"
import type { SfProductStatePort } from "../../../product/contracts/state.ts"

/** INERT DRAFT: not applied, typechecked or executed.
 * Intended location, if the mission owner accepts it:
 * test/product/portfolio-runtime-qualification/c08-observation-probe.ts
 *
 * Install only around one awaited observation in an exclusive diagnostic test
 * using the real LocalStore fixture. This is not a performance assertion, a
 * replacement for P03, or proof of which native clone callsite dominates P03.
 */
type Timing = { calls: number; elapsedMs: number; maximumMs: number }
type TransactionFrame = {
  surface: string
  rootSurface: string
  depth: number
  entered: boolean
}
type ReadFrame = { namespace: string; ordinal: number }

export function installC08ObservationProbe(persistence: Persistence, state: SfProductStatePort) {
  const observing = new AsyncLocalStorage<boolean>()
  const transactions = new AsyncLocalStorage<TransactionFrame>()
  const reads = new AsyncLocalStorage<ReadFrame>()
  const originalTransaction = persistence.transaction
  const originalSnapshots = persistence.currentSnapshots
  const originalRead = state.read
  const originalClone = globalThis.structuredClone
  const metrics: Record<string, Timing> = {}
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {}
  let readOrdinal = 0
  let observations = 0
  let observationElapsedMs = 0
  let active = false
  let restored = false

  const count = (name: string) => { counts[name] = (counts[name] ?? 0) + 1 }
  const record = (name: string, elapsedMs: number) => {
    const entry = metrics[name] ??= { calls: 0, elapsedMs: 0, maximumMs: 0 }
    entry.calls++
    entry.elapsedMs += elapsedMs
    entry.maximumMs = Math.max(entry.maximumMs, elapsedMs)
  }
  const transactionLabel = (frame: TransactionFrame) =>
    `${frame.depth === 0 ? "root" : "nested"}.${frame.rootSurface}.${frame.surface}`

  // Do not wrap or replace the state reader callback. The provider recognizes
  // selected-case callbacks by WeakMap identity; changing that identity would
  // change the product path being measured.
  const wrappedRead: SfProductStatePort["read"] = function (request, namespace, reader) {
    if (!observing.getStore()) return originalRead.call(state, request, namespace, reader)
    const frame = { namespace, ordinal: ++readOrdinal }
    count(`state.read.${namespace}`)
    return reads.run(frame, () => originalRead.call(state, request, namespace, reader))
  } as SfProductStatePort["read"]

  const wrappedTransaction: Persistence["transaction"] = function (surface, work, options) {
    if (!observing.getStore()) return originalTransaction.call(persistence, surface, work, options)
    const parent = transactions.getStore()
    const frame = { surface, rootSurface: parent?.rootSurface ?? surface, depth: (parent?.depth ?? -1) + 1, entered: false }
    const label = transactionLabel(frame)
    const started = performance.now()
    let originalReturned = false
    count(`transaction.invocations.${label}`)
    try {
      // The original Promise is returned unchanged. No then/finally is attached
      // to production promises, and the work result is returned unchanged.
      return transactions.run(frame, () => originalTransaction.call(persistence, surface, (snapshot) => {
        const elapsedMs = performance.now() - started
        frame.entered = true
        count(`transaction.callbackInvocations.${label}`)
        record(`transaction.callbackEntry.${originalReturned ? "async" : "sync"}.${label}`, elapsedMs)
        return work(snapshot)
      }, options))
    } finally {
      originalReturned = true
    }
  } as Persistence["transaction"]

  const wrappedSnapshots: NonNullable<Persistence["currentSnapshots"]> = function () {
    if (!observing.getStore()) return originalSnapshots!.call(persistence)
    const frame = transactions.getStore()
    const label = frame ? transactionLabel(frame) : "outside"
    const started = performance.now()
    try { return originalSnapshots!.call(persistence) }
    finally { record(`currentSnapshots.${label}`, performance.now() - started) }
  }

  const wrappedClone: typeof structuredClone = function (...args: Parameters<typeof structuredClone>) {
    if (!observing.getStore()) return Reflect.apply(originalClone, this, args)
    const frame = transactions.getStore()
    const read = reads.getStore()
    // No input-property inspection, stack capture, descriptor traversal, extra
    // clone, serializer, callback invocation or result retention is introduced.
    const phase = frame ? `${transactionLabel(frame)}.${frame.entered ? "callback" : "admission"}` : "outside"
    const label = `structuredClone.${read ? `stateRead.${read.namespace}` : "outsideStateRead"}.${phase}`
    const started = performance.now()
    try { return Reflect.apply(originalClone, this, args) }
    finally { record(label, performance.now() - started) }
  } as typeof structuredClone

  persistence.transaction = wrappedTransaction
  if (originalSnapshots) persistence.currentSnapshots = wrappedSnapshots
  state.read = wrappedRead
  globalThis.structuredClone = wrappedClone

  return {
    async observe<T>(work: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
      if (restored || active || observations !== 0) throw new Error("Diagnostic accepts exactly one exclusive observation")
      observations++
      active = true
      const started = performance.now()
      try { return await observing.run(true, work) }
      finally { observationElapsedMs = performance.now() - started; active = false }
    },
    snapshot() {
      return {
        observations,
        active,
        observationElapsedMs,
        counts: { ...counts },
        metrics: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(metrics).map(([name, value]) => [name, { ...value }])),
        interpretation: {
          callbackEntrySync: "Synchronous invocation-to-callback interval: runtime admission, validation and copying plus probe overhead; not copy-only time.",
          callbackEntryAsync: "Includes waits and queue time; do not attribute it to copying.",
          stateReadClones: "Native structuredClone spans during an unchanged state.read callback context; aggregate provenance, not exclusive provider callsite attribution.",
          scopes: "Root/nested labels describe this probe's call ancestry, not an independently granted runtime authority.",
          overhead: "Timers and AsyncLocalStorage add uncalibrated overhead. Durations are diagnostic and have no ratio or timeout assertion.",
        },
      }
    },
    restore() {
      if (active) throw new Error("Await the diagnostic observation before restoring")
      if (restored) return
      // A competing mutation must not be silently overwritten by cleanup.
      if (persistence.transaction === wrappedTransaction) persistence.transaction = originalTransaction
      if (originalSnapshots && persistence.currentSnapshots === wrappedSnapshots) persistence.currentSnapshots = originalSnapshots
      if (state.read === wrappedRead) state.read = originalRead
      if (globalThis.structuredClone === wrappedClone) globalThis.structuredClone = originalClone
      restored = true
    },
  }
}
